additional_info.subject: FW: ID0459698-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP/R5 170001937] Out of service. CRM:02889000816
additional_info.body:
Bonjour ,
L'analyse :
Veuillez vérifier l’unité de refroidissement. Le niveau du réservoir de liquide de refroidissement est en dessous du seuil d’alerte, donc assurez-vous d’apporter du liquide de refroidissement. Veuillez également vérifier la communication entre l’unité de refroidissement et l’automate (PLC).
Pouvez-vous nous confirmer si vous disposez de techniciens certifiés pour effectuer cette intervention, ou souhaitez-vous recevoir un devis ?

additional_info.subject: Re: FW: ID0459698-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP/R5 170001937] Out of service. CRM:02889000816
additional_info.body:
Hello,
We have checked the coolant level and the level is now correct.
However, the charging station with the water-cooled cable is still showing a fault.
Do you still have the “low level” fault? If so, it seems that the issue may come from the coolant low-level sensor.
The sensor wire enters the tank through a white cable gland — how can we access it?
Attached is a photo of the digital inputs on the PLC; which digital input corresponds to the low-level signal?
Is it possible to obtain the electrical diagrams of the charging station?
Thank you.
Ancion Christophe
Administrateur

344, rue de Pontillas

additional_info.body:

Looking at the schematics, the CAN bus doesn’t seem to control anything other than the power modules. The cooling unit appears to be controlled via Modbus RTU.
I’ve just checked the wiring between the cooling unit module (Hydac pump) and the PLC, and everything seems fine. Could the issue be coming from the pump itself, which includes the RS485 communication?
Is it possible to have access to the full charger log in real time?
When are you available so we can look into it together?
Regards

Please do not create notes in the ticket, send an email so I can receive an notification.
The issue is in the CCS HPC cable and not in the Cooling Pump. There is no need to replace the pump.

additional_info.body:
Dear Mark,
I would like to inform you that Bart is no longer working with us.
Kindly provide a purchase order number, or alternatively, please sign and return the attached quotation at your earliest convenience.
Please also note that replacing a liquid-cooled cable requires two technicians, and the estimated time for the replacement is approximately three hours. The final cost will be confirmed upon completion of the repair.
The order has already been processed, and I will schedule the site visit as soon as the parts have arrived.
Thank you in advance for your cooperation.
Kind regards,
